hypothesis: OnclickMedia free historical EOD options chains can fill Ginger's options data gap as a default-off append-only source for daily production accumulation and historical backfill, enabling later shadow overlays without changing live trading decisions.

alpha_hypothesis.entry_exit_ranking_or_allocation: ranking/risk overlay for existing breakout/event/earnings candidates, not standalone entry
alpha_hypothesis.text: IV, skew, term structure, OI concentration, and put/call structure may help distinguish squeeze-supportive breakout/event candidates, downside-risk candidates, and earnings IV-crush risk candidates.
alpha_hypothesis.why_not_direct_alpha_test: Prior audits found zero local options rows. This run first adds the append-only source adapter needed before any forward-return or slot-conflict shadow overlay can be measured.

non_ohlcv_data_source.name: OnclickMedia historical EOD options chain API
non_ohlcv_data_source.source_caveat: Free public-source aggregation feed; use coverage and quality audits before treating historical rows as production-grade evidence.

historical_experiment_check.why_not_simple_repeat: This is not another no-data audit; it adds the missing adapter/backfill/daily accumulation harness requested by the prior options data-gap records.

decision_rationale: Accept as a default-off data harness because it fills the local options data gap and allows both forward accumulation and historical coverage audits. Do not treat historical backfill rows as PIT-safe production evidence without additional vendor/as-of validation.
next_action: Run nightly production to accumulate forward PIT rows; separately backfill the three canonical windows for existing Ginger candidate tickers, then run a shadow overlay report with 5/10/20/60d forward returns and slot-conflict value.
